cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Unknown is not empty or permanently impossible; retain offers/assignment/randomness/quote; no new credit based on missing evidence.

cases.trigger: Required equipment temporarily banked, sold or missing
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Preserve assignment; existing legal access/reacquisition/Pause/Reject only. No new off-task permission.

cases.trigger: Finite Slayer task ends or player changes unsupported method
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: No off-task credit or automatic replacement. Task-dependent catalog remains held under WB-D140; no reacquisition waiver.

cases.trigger: Challenge pool falls from three eligible creatures to two after target commitment
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: New Challenge offers unavailable; already committed creature/item remains. Diversity count is not a cancellation condition.

cases.trigger: Current rate or allocation becomes unknown/out of band
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Preserve hunt/item/reward and evidence; do not accept a newly unsupported context or choose another target. Reviewed permanent invalidation remains open.

cases.trigger: Fresh current evidence again supports the same frozen source/context
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Revalidate identity/context and active evidence boundary; continue same target/reward. No paused-progress backfill.

cases.trigger: Price or reward schedule changes after offer commitment
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Keep existing frozen quote/version; new schedules govern future offers only.

cases.trigger: Catalog omits target but source disappearance is not proven
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Missing catalog row is not external impossibility. Preserve original payload; no silent substitution or reseed.

cases.trigger: Old account/session callback or repeated callback arrives
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Reject stale identity; recognized duplicate uses existing receipt, no second debit/payment.

cases.trigger: Completion already settled before later source change
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Keep legitimate once-only settlement and player item; no new reward replay or invalidation-based clawback.

cases.trigger: Prechange active receipt still unsettled when player pauses
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Preserve earning-time evidence; no payment while paused. Existing reviewed reconciliation required, not automatic backfill or denial.

cases.trigger: Unknown future save schema or migration failure
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Retain original state and last-good payload; no destructive reset, merge, fabricated retirement or reward.

cases.trigger: Selected ordinary target permanently impossible in every supported context after verified game change
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Recommended narrowly reviewed no-fault retirement is PROPOSED only. Existing Pause/Reject remain current until answered.

cases.trigger: Offer set committed but not selected when eligibility changes
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: Preserve full set and seeds; hold unresolved selection. Detailed invalid-offer reconciliation is not settled by selected-assignment retirement.
Do not apply proposed ordinary retirement, skip specials or erase mandatory obligations. Coffer Q2 remains evidence-gated.

cases.trigger: Crash/restart during a future approved no-fault retirement
cases.required_or_proposed_behavior: If approved, atomic idempotent assignment-scoped retirement receipt releases only its actual outstanding ordinary reservation; no duplicate spin grant or penalty bypass.

recommendation: For a selected ordinary assignment made impossible in every qualifying context by an evidenced external game change, reviewed no-fault retirement: no completion reward, FP penalty, Punishment or consumed allotted spin; preserve receipts and independent settled bounties. Never a player-selected reroll or mandatory-special waiver. Exact debit correction must use actual ledger/reservation, not a blanket +1 grant.
residual_open: Exact durable schema/client proof and reviewed invalidation evidence format
